result.brief: 提出跨外观自对齐的自监督训练框架，用EMA教师对齐扰动观测的动作表征，提升世界动作模型对视觉扰动的鲁棒性并降低视频特征的外观敏感性。
result.reason: Proposes self-supervised cross-appearance alignment of action representations in world action models, with layer-wise video feature diagnostics; contributes to representation learning within video world models.
